r: [low voice] Oh hi, caught anything already?
You don't seem to be used to people coming over here.
About the few people who come this way ...
About the monsters along the way here ...

brute_fisherman_10.m: So what's stopping people from using the route?
r: I will find out and tell you.
That's easy to say. I went that route recently after all.
Did you see my brother Andor lately? He looks a bit like me.

brute_fisherman_14.m: I don't know. Here it is one day like another.

brute_fisherman_16.m: If he comes by again, I'll tell him that you asked about him.

brute_fisherman_2.m: Sigh. OK, let's talk. The fish have already fled anyway.

brute_fisherman_20.m: Have you been able to find out why the path is rarely used anymore?
r: Yes. There are many vicious monsters such as wolves or poisonous spiders. But Arulir and different brutes in particular haunt the area.
It's a long and boring road. Simply because of that.

brute_fisherman_22.m: Yes, it has always been long.

brute_fisherman_24.m: Please go and take a closer look. There must be more to it.

brute_fisherman_30.m: Ohh! Do not keep me in suspense.
r: I have discovered a cave where brutes seem to pour out.
I have discovered a cave, but I don't know what's inside.

brute_fisherman_32.m: Oh interesting. What did you find in the cave?
r: It was full of monsters. I didn't dare go in deeper.
It was full of monsters. But that wasn't everything.

brute_fisherman_35.m: Please find out what's in the cave. Then I can tell my wife a good story in the evening.

brute_fisherman_4.m: Well yes, you're right. There was a time when this path was almost crowded.

brute_fisherman_40.m: Finally tell - what was so exciting in the cave?
r: All the brutes along the coast actually come from this cave.
Yes, I saw it with my own eyes.
I have talked to Os. He claims to be a researcher who turns rats into these brutes to study them.
I don't understand how he does it exactly, but the rats become these brutes in several stages.
There are several bake rooms where the animals take on an even more hideous appearance. Until they finally come out of the cave as brutes.

brute_fisherman_5.m: It's hard to imagine now. I'm not used to people coming here anymore.

brute_fisherman_6.m: But I want to introduce myself first. My name is Bidro, I live in Remgard.
r:
Nice to meet you. I am $playername.
Ehm, may I ask you a question?
From a distance I would have thought you were a woman. Why are you wearing women's clothes?

brute_fisherman_7b.m: Because I can. Period, no discussion.
r: Oh, your sensitive spot, sorry. Let us talk about something else.

brute_fisherman_8.m: You just came using this path. Do you know why it's been used so little lately?

brute_fisherman_90.m: Now I know where these brutes suddenly come from.

brute_fisherman_92.m: My wife will love this story!

brute_fisherman_94.m: ... and won't believe a word I say.

brute_creator.20: I told Bidro about the many nasty monsters along the way.
brute_creator.30: I have discovered a cave where brutes seem to pour out.
brute_creator.35: Then I have told Bidro about this cave full of brutes.
brute_creator.40: I have talked to Os, a scientist about brute matters. He has built up a brute production facility.
brute_creator.90: I told Bidro what I have learned from Os. He thanked me for this new story he could tell his wife.
